title: Saturday Partner WOD
warmup: With your partner, 2 rounds: Walking Lunge × 10/side · Inchworm Push-Up × 6 · Bird Dog × 8/side

cond.subtitle: Split reps any way · one works, one rests
cond.scaling: Solo? Halve the reps · sled taken? 80 yd Farmer's Carry

note: Pick a partner close to your pace. Talk to each other the whole time.
